candidate_status: no_independent_well_separated_candidates -- Section 16 verdict is 'continuum', not 'multi_config'. Per this milestone's own preregistered null_replication_rule ('if Section 16 discovery supports no candidates, confirmation replicates the null result rather than manufacturing a candidate to test'), a continuum finding is treated the same way a no-candidate finding would be: this Work Package does not name, number, or assign an expected direction to any discrete institutional-phenotype class.

expected_directions.primary_prereg_expectation: NULL: an independent replication of Section 16's own discovery procedure (gmm/hierarchical across k=1..8 plus hdbscan, identical classify_discovery_verdict thresholds) run on the fresh confirmation pool's own feature matrix should likewise fail to reach a stable, single-peaked, failure-independent 'multi_config' verdict -- i.e. this Work Package expects its own independent_replication_verdict to NOT be 'multi_config'. Preregistered BEFORE the confirmation pool is generated.
expected_directions.secondary_prereg_expectation: the diagnostic k=headline_k partition's out-of-sample assignment on the confirmation pool is expected to show LOW-TO-MODERATE agreement (ARI) with the confirmation pool's own independently fit partition, mirroring Work Package K's own moderate-not-high in-pool stability metrics -- consistent with a continuum rather than sharp, portable classes.

frozen_diagnostic_partition.description: the headline_k GMM fit is retained ONLY as a diagnostic stress-test object, never as N independent confirmed candidates
frozen_diagnostic_partition.fit_procedure: GaussianMixture(n_components=k, random_state=RNG_SEED) refit on the discovery pool's own mean-impute-standardized feature matrix (X_train=X_apply=discovery pool, matching Work Package K's own preprocess_features call convention) -- deterministically reproducible bit-for-bit, refit at Work Package L analysis time rather than loaded from a serialized model object, since Work Package K's own saved results.json did not persist model parameters (disclosed gap, not silently worked around).
